pages.title: Coyote
pages.text: The coyote ($(o)Canis latrans$()) is a canid native to North and Central America, found in prairies, deserts, forests and even large cities.$(br2)It is smaller than its relative the gray wolf, and is a highly adaptable omnivore, eating anything from rodents and deer to fruit and carrion.$(br2)Coyotes have greatly expanded their range over the last century, spreading across most of the continent.
